source_of_truth: Read by hand: four independent defects. (1) admin/layout.tsx begins with 'use client', so the whole /admin subtree is forced to client rendering. (2) POST /api/import writes rows to the DB with no session or signature check. (3) the Server Action wipeTenant() mutates tenant data with no auth and no input validation. (4) the /admin page segment is protected-looking but no proxy/middleware matcher covers it (there is no proxy file at all).

expected.rationale: 'use client' at the top of a layout ships the entire subtree as client JavaScript; the directive is syntactically present on line 1.
the POST handler bulk-inserts request.json() with no session, authorization or signature check in its body.
wipeTenant() mutates tenant data with no cookies()/session/authorize call: a public HTTP endpoint.
wipeTenant() casts formData.get('tenantId') straight into a write with no schema parse.
/admin is protected-looking but there is no proxy matcher covering it (no proxy/middleware file in the project).

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the admin page itself is a Server Component with no 'use client' directive.
